root_idea.summary: An elevated, overhanging form, with an associated idea of bending or bowing.
root_idea.development: The semantic development centers on the roof or ceiling as something high and projecting, extends to the sky as the earth’s roof and to roofed structures or boards, and yields related descriptions of tall, bent forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun is presented under its normalized singular citation form سَقْف.

senses.definition: A roof, ceiling, or overhead covering.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a roof or ceiling of a house or other structure, and for an overhead covering described as protective. The singular can carry a plural sense in the Quranic expression referring to roofs of silver.

senses.definition: The sky or heaven, conceived as a roof over the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: A specialized Quran-attested application in which the heavens are understood as the elevated covering or roof of the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a roof or ceiling for a house, chamber, or tent; to roof or cover a structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II derivative may convey intensive force; the forms are explicitly cross-referenced within this roofing construction.
A Form V denominative or derived construction referring to attaining the office of bishop.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall and bent or bowed; in one usage, thick-boned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people and animals, including an ostrich or she-camel; the descriptions concern height, curvature, or bodily build rather than a roof itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long, flaccid, or pendulous, especially of the jaw or the part on which the beard grows.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a camel lacking fur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A roofed or covered place, such as a portico, porch, projecting shelter, or covered passage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote a covered portion of a building or street and similar roofed structures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broad piece of wood or stone used as a roof, covering, or structural board.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a board used over a hunter’s lurking-place, flat pieces used to cover a hollow, and a broad board laid above house roofs for reed mats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plank of a ship or boat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized extended use, apparently referring to a plank of the deck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single cranial bone of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel’s cranial bones are termed سَقَائِفُ collectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single rib of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel’s ribs are termed سَقَائِفُ collectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A splint used to set or support a fractured bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A piece of wood or similar material applied in bone treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of gold or silver beaten thin and long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended material use for thin, elongated beaten metal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose occupation is constructing roofs or ceilings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun derived from the roofing sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bishop: a Christian religious headman or learned religious authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One description places the office above a presbyter and below a metropolitan; an alternative account describes a ruler who affects humility in his gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or rank of a bishop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting episcopal office rather than the person holding it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide in the bone or bones of the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily description referring to broad skeletal structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Raised, shaggy, dishevelled, or disordered hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to the condition or arrangement of hair.
